title: Proverbs 1:1
content: 1 {These are} the wise sayings said by Solomon. {He was} David’s son and Israel’s king.

title: Proverbs 1:2
content: 2 {These wise sayings are} for knowing what is wise and instructive. {They are} for understanding insightful things that people say.

title: Proverbs 1:3
content: 3 {These wise sayings are} for instructing someone about what is insightful, righteous, just, and honest.

title: Proverbs 1:4
content: 4 {They are} for making naive people prudent, and {for making} young people knowledgeable and discreet.

title: Proverbs 1:5
content: 5 (Let wise people listen {to these wise sayings} and learn more. Indeed, {let these sayings} guide understanding people so that they know what to do.)

title: Proverbs 1:6
content: 6 {These wise sayings are} for understanding wise sayings and parables. {Indeed, they are for understanding} what wise people say and the riddles they tell.

title: Proverbs 1:7
content: 7 In order to become knowledgeable, a person must begin by deeply respecting Yahweh. {But} foolish people detest what is wise or instructive.

title: Proverbs 1:8
content: 8 My child, listen carefully to what I, your father, am teaching you. Indeed, obey the rules that your mother has commanded.

title: Proverbs 1:9
content: 9 {Obey your parents’ teaching} because then {people will admire and respect you;} it will be as if those teachings were an attractive wreath on your head, or beautiful necklaces around your neck.

title: Proverbs 1:10
content: 10 My child, if sinful people tempt you {to sin with them}, refuse {to do so}.

title: Proverbs 1:11
content: 11 Those sinful people may say, “Join us! We will hide and wait in order to kill someone {who walks by}. Indeed, we will hide ourselves in order to suddenly attack an innocent person for no good reason.

title: Proverbs 1:12
content: 12 We will kill living people completely, as if we were their grave. {Yes, we will kill} healthy people, as if they could not escape dying.

title: Proverbs 1:13
content: 13 We will discover many valuable treasures! We will fill our houses with what we steal!

title: Proverbs 1:14
content: 14 Join our gang! We will share all the loot between us.”

title: Proverbs 1:15
content: 15 My child, do not associate with those sinful people! Prevent yourself from doing the things that they do!

title: Proverbs 1:16
content: 16 {Avoid those sinners} because they are eager to do wicked things. They even rush to murder people.

title: Proverbs 1:17
content: 17 It is useless {for a hunter} to put out a net {to trap a bird} while the bird is watching {because the bird will avoid the net}.

title: Proverbs 1:18
content: 18 However, {these sinful people are more foolish than birds.} They hide in wait, but they kill themselves. Indeed, they hide so that they can suddenly attack, but they themselves die.

title: Proverbs 1:19
content: 19 That is what happens to anyone who gains wealth in an unjust manner. What they gained unjustly will kill them.

title: Proverbs 1:20
content: 20 Imagine that everything that is wise is a woman who calls out {to everyone} in public. Imagine that this woman shouts {to people} in crowded places.

title: Proverbs 1:21
content: 21 Imagine that she calls out {to people} at the place where busy streets intersect. Imagine that she speaks her {wise} words at the {crowded} entrance of the city gates.

title: Proverbs 1:22
content: 22 She says, “You naive people have loved being naive for too long! You people who ridicule {others} have enjoyed ridiculing {others} to benefit yourselves for too long! You foolish people have hated what you should know for too long!

title: Proverbs 1:23
content: 23 Turn around {and listen} to me when I correct you! Listen! I will tell you all that I am thinking. Indeed, I will help you to understand what I have to say to you.

title: Proverbs 1:24
content: 24 I called out {to you}, but you refused {to listen}. Indeed, I invited you to come to me, but no one paid any attention {to me}.

title: Proverbs 1:25
content: 25 You ignored everything that I advised you to do. Indeed, you rejected what I said to correct you.

title: Proverbs 1:26
content: 26 Therefore, as for me, I will laugh at you when disastrous things happen to you. Indeed, I will ridicule you when you are terrified.

title: Proverbs 1:27
content: 27 {Yes,} when you are terrified as if a violent storm has arrived, {when} disastrous things happen to you violently, {and} when you become distressed and anguished{, I will ridicule you}!

title: Proverbs 1:28
content: 28 At that time, those foolish people will cry out to me {to help them}, but I will not reply {to them}. Indeed, they will desperately look for me, but they will not be able to find me.

title: Proverbs 1:29
content: 29 {Those foolish people will not find me} because they refuse to learn. Also, they have decided not to respect Yahweh.

title: Proverbs 1:30
content: 30 Those foolish people rejected what I advised them to do. Indeed, they detested everything I said to correct them.

title: Proverbs 1:31
content: 31 Those foolish people will suffer rightly for what they have done. Indeed, they will suffer fully for what they have planned.

title: Proverbs 1:32
content: 32 Ultimately, naive people will die because they refuse {to be wise}. Indeed, being complacent will destroy foolish people.

title: Proverbs 1:33
content: 33 By contrast, people who listen attentively to what I say will live safely. They will not fear that something evil might happen to them.”

title: Proverbs 2:1
content: 1 My child, accept what I say. Consider what I command {you} to be precious.

title: Proverbs 2:2
content: 2 {Do this by} listening carefully to what is wise, {and by} thinking seriously about what you should understand.

title: Proverbs 2:3
content: 3 Yes, cry out {to God} for {him to show you} what you should perceive. Call loudly {to God} for {him to teach you} what you should understand!

title: Proverbs 2:4
content: 4 Try to learn what is wise as eagerly as you would try to find silver. Indeed, look for it as you would look for a treasure that someone has hidden.

title: Proverbs 2:5
content: 5 {If you do those things,} then you will understand how to reverently fear Yahweh. {If you do those things,} then you will be able to know God.

title: Proverbs 2:6
content: 6 {This is} because Yahweh provides people with what is wise. He tells them what they should know and understand.

title: Proverbs 2:7
content: 7 He gives what is truly wise to upright people. He protects people who behave honestly.

title: Proverbs 2:8
content: 8 {He does these things} in order to guard those people who live justly. Indeed, he keeps safe those people who are faithful to him.

title: Proverbs 2:9
content: 9 {If you listen to me,} then you will understand what is righteous, just, and honest— all the best ways to behave.

title: Proverbs 2:10
content: 10 {This is because} you will truly know what is wise, and knowing {what is wise} will please you.

title: Proverbs 2:11
content: 11 Being able to choose wisely will make you safe. Indeed, being able to understand {what is happening around you} will make you secure.

title: Proverbs 2:12
content: 12 {Being wise like this} will keep you from doing wicked things, {and you will stay away} from people who speak perversely.

title: Proverbs 2:13
content: 13 Those people refuse to behave righteously in order to behave wickedly.

title: Proverbs 2:14
content: 14 They gladly do what is wrong. They enjoy doing things that are perverse and evil.

title: Proverbs 2:15
content: 15 They behave deceptively. Indeed, they act deviously.

title: Proverbs 2:16
content: 16 {Being discreet and insightful} will protect you {also} from adulterous women. {Being discreet and insightful will save you} from immoral women who speak {to you} seductively.

title: Proverbs 2:17
content: 17 Those women left the husbands they married when they were young. They even forgot what they had promised to God {when they married}.

title: Proverbs 2:18
content: 18 {Being discreet and insightful will rescue you} because {going to} such a woman’s house will cause you to die. Indeed, going with her is the same as going to the place where the spirits of dead people are.

title: Proverbs 2:19
content: 19 No man who acts adulterously with her will live again. He will no longer be able to live in a way that results in life with God.

title: Proverbs 2:20
content: 20 Therefore, behave like a good person. Indeed, conduct yourself like a righteous person.

title: Proverbs 2:21
content: 21 This is important because {only} people who live uprightly will live in our land, Indeed, it is the people who do not act wickedly who will stay in this land for a long time.

title: Proverbs 2:22
content: 22 By contrast, Yahweh will remove people who act wickedly from our land. Be sure of this: Yahweh will completely remove people who act treacherously from this land!

title: Proverbs 3:1
content: 1 My child, remember the rules I have taught you! Always be mindful to obey what I have commanded you!

title: Proverbs 3:2
content: 2 {Do this} because {obeying} what I have commanded you will help you live for a long time with many fulfilling and peaceful years.

title: Proverbs 3:3
content: 3 Always be faithful and trustworthy. Let everyone see {how faithful and trustworthy you are, as if} they were a necklace you are wearing. Remember to be faithful and trustworthy at all times.

title: Proverbs 3:4
content: 4 As a result of doing so, both God and people will approve of you and consider you an insightful person.

title: Proverbs 3:5
content: 5 Trust Yahweh completely, and do not rely on what you understand.

title: Proverbs 3:6
content: 6 Let Yahweh lead you whenever you do anything. As a result {of doing so}, he will show you what you should do.

title: Proverbs 3:7
content: 7 Do not think that you know what is best. Instead, revere Yahweh and refuse to do what is evil.

title: Proverbs 3:8
content: 8 Doing so will make your body healthy. Indeed, {doing so} will strengthen you from the inside.

title: Proverbs 3:9
content: 9 Revere Yahweh {by giving to him} some of your riches, and {by giving to him} some of the first {crops} from everything that you harvest.

title: Proverbs 3:10
content: 10 {Doing so} will result in your places for storing crops becoming completely full {of crops}. Even your containers for wine will overflow with fresh wine.

title: Proverbs 3:11
content: 11 My child, do not refuse to listen when Yahweh corrects you. Do not be resentful even when he rebukes you.

title: Proverbs 3:12
content: 12 {Do not respond in that way} because Yahweh {only} reproves the people whom he loves, just as a father reproves the children whom he cherishes.

title: Proverbs 3:13
content: 13 People who become wise are happy. Indeed, the people who understand {Yahweh’s world are the ones who} are truly happy.

title: Proverbs 3:14
content: 14 {This is} because being wise benefits people more than silver {could benefit them}. Indeed, being wise is worth more to people than having gold.

title: Proverbs 3:15
content: 15 Being wise is more valuable than precious jewels. There is nothing that you could desire that is worth as much as being wise.

title: Proverbs 3:16
content: 16 Being wise will help you live for a long time. Being wise will help you become wealthy and honorable.

title: Proverbs 3:17
content: 17 Being wise will allow you to live pleasantly. Indeed, in every way being wise will allow you to live peacefully.

title: Proverbs 3:18
content: 18 What is wise is {like} a tree {with fruit} that sustains the people who possess it, People who are consistently wise live happily.

title: Proverbs 3:19
content: 19 Yahweh made the world through being wise. Through being skillful, he made the sky and everything in it.

title: Proverbs 3:20
content: 20 Through knowing all things, Yahweh made water burst forth from deep {below the earth} and he made water fall from the clouds {above}.

title: Proverbs 3:21
content: 21 My child, always remember to do what is prudent and brings a good outcome. Always be mindful to do those things.

title: Proverbs 3:22
content: 22 Doing so will give you a satisfying life and people will honor and respect you.

title: Proverbs 3:23
content: 23 Doing what is prudent and good will {also} cause you to live safely. They will keep you from making any serious mistakes.

title: Proverbs 3:24
content: 24 When you lie down {to sleep}, you will not fear anything. You will lie down {to sleep} and sleep peacefully.

title: Proverbs 3:25
content: 25 Do not worry about something terrible suddenly happening {to you}, or about {what will happen} when God destroys wicked people.

title: Proverbs 3:26
content: 26 {Do not worry} because Yahweh will make you confident. He will not allow people to harm you.

title: Proverbs 3:27
content: 27 Do not refrain from giving what is good to people who deserve it when you are able to do so.

title: Proverbs 3:28
content: 28 When you are with a friend {who needs something}, and you have it with you, do not tell that person, “Go away and come back tomorrow. I will give it to you then.”

title: Proverbs 3:29
content: 29 Do not plan to harm people that you interact with, because they live near you and they trust you.

title: Proverbs 3:30
content: 30 Do not argue needlessly with someone who has not harmed you.

title: Proverbs 3:31
content: 31 Do not envy violent people. Do not imitate anything they do.

title: Proverbs 3:32
content: 32 {Do not do so} because Yahweh detests {such} people who act wickedly, but he converses like a friend with people who act uprightly.

title: Proverbs 3:33
content: 33 Yahweh causes bad things to happen to the families of wicked people, but he causes good things to happen to the families of righteous people.

title: Proverbs 3:34
content: 34 When people ridicule {others}, it is Yahweh who ridicules them, but he kindly helps those who are humble.

title: Proverbs 3:35
content: 35 People will honor wise people, but people will shame foolish people.

title: Proverbs 4:1
content: 1 Children, listen carefully to what I, your father, am teaching you. Pay attention in order to learn what you should understand.

title: Proverbs 4:2
content: 2 {Do this} because what I am teaching you is good. {So} remember the rules that I am teaching you.

title: Proverbs 4:3
content: 3 When I was just a boy with my father, {and} my mother’s delicate, only son.

title: Proverbs 4:4
content: 4 During that time, my father taught me. He told me, “Remember what I have told you! Do what I have commanded you, so that you will keep on living!

title: Proverbs 4:5
content: 5 Learn what is wise and what you should understand! Always remember and keep doing the things that I have said to you!

title: Proverbs 4:6
content: 6 Keep doing what is wise, because doing so will keep you safe. Love doing what is wise, because being wise will protect you from harm.

title: Proverbs 4:7
content: 7 Being wise is the most important thing. {So} become wise! {Even if} it costs you everything that you own, become a person who understands {God’s world}!

title: Proverbs 4:8
content: 8 Prize what is wise, so that you will become great. People will honor you when you value what is wise.

title: Proverbs 4:9
content: 9 Being wise will make you {respectable,} as though you had an attractive wreath on your head. Indeed, being wise will make you {honorable,} as though you were wearing a magnificent crown.”

title: Proverbs 4:10
content: 10 My child, listen attentively and accept what I say. Doing so will increase the number of years that you live.

title: Proverbs 4:11
content: 11 I instructed you in how to act wisely. I directed you in how to live in the right way.

title: Proverbs 4:12
content: 12 {If you follow my teaching,} nothing will hinder you {from succeeding}. Indeed, if you attempt great things, you will do well.

title: Proverbs 4:13
content: 13 Consistently remember the things I have instructed you; keep remembering them! Always be mindful of them, because they will keep you alive.

title: Proverbs 4:14
content: 14 Do not do what wicked people do. Indeed, do not behave in the way that evil people behave.

title: Proverbs 4:15
content: 15 Shun doing what is evil. Do not even consider doing it! Refuse to act wickedly and do something else.

title: Proverbs 4:16
content: 16 {Do not act wickedly} because {it is as if} evil people cannot even sleep unless they have done something evil {on that day}; {it is as if} they cannot rest unless they hurt someone.

title: Proverbs 4:17
content: 17 {Do not act wickedly} because evil people do wicked things as if they were eating food; they violently hurt others as if they were drinking wine.

title: Proverbs 4:18
content: 18 As for righteous people, they will live {wisely and safely} as people do who walk in the sunshine; {they will live more and more wisely and safely,} just as the sun shines brighter and brighter until the brightest time of day.

title: Proverbs 4:19
content: 19 {But} the way that wicked people live is {dangerous,} like people {who walk} in total darkness. {Like people walking in darkness do not know} what they trip over, wicked people do not know {what hurts them}.

title: Proverbs 4:20
content: 20 My child, pay attention to what I am saying to you! Listen carefully to what I say!

title: Proverbs 4:21
content: 21 Keep thinking about what I say! Fully commit yourself to remembering such things!

title: Proverbs 4:22
content: 22 {Do this} because those who live according to my words will have good lives, and their whole bodies will be healthy.

title: Proverbs 4:23
content: 23 More than anything else, be extremely careful about what you think and desire, because those things will control how you live.

title: Proverbs 4:24
content: 24 Do not say anything that deceives people. Indeed, never say anything that misleads people.

title: Proverbs 4:25
content: 25 {Focus on doing what is right, like} someone who is always looking straight ahead. Indeed, {act like} someone who is looking straight in front of himself.

title: Proverbs 4:26
content: 26 Plan carefully to do things in the right way. As a result {of doing so}, you will succeed in everything that you do.

title: Proverbs 4:27
content: 27 Do not do anything other than what is right. Prevent yourself from doing what is evil.

title: Proverbs 5:1
content: 1 My son, pay attention to the wise things that I tell you! Listen carefully to what I say you should understand!

title: Proverbs 5:2
content: 2 {Do this} so that you will be able to choose wisely {what to do}, and {so that} you will know the {right} things to say.

title: Proverbs 5:3
content: 3 {Do this} because what adulterous women say seems delightful like the taste of honey. Yes, their words are more soothing than how olive oil feels on your skin.

title: Proverbs 5:4
content: 4 However, after being with such a woman you will be miserable, as if you had eaten a bitter plant. {You will suffer} like a person whom someone has cut with a sharp, double-edged sword.

title: Proverbs 5:5
content: 5 {Being with} such a woman will cause both of you to die. Indeed, what she does {with you} will cause you to become a dead person.

title: Proverbs 5:6
content: 6 She does not want to do what will cause her to live well. She does not realize that she {lives precariously like someone who} is walking on a broken path.

title: Proverbs 5:7
content: 7 So now, children, pay attention to what I say! Always remember what I have spoken to you!

title: Proverbs 5:8
content: 8 Stay far away from any adulterous woman! Do not even go near the door of the place where such a woman dwells!

title: Proverbs 5:9
content: 9 If you go to such a woman, you will be giving the best efforts of your youth to others, and a merciless person will take away {everything that you would gain in} the best time of your life.

title: Proverbs 5:10
content: 10 If you go to such a woman, people you do not know will satisfy themselves with {what you produced} when you were strong, and an outsider will fill his house with what you labored to gain.

title: Proverbs 5:11
content: 11 Then you will groan when you are about to die and have worn out your whole body.

title: Proverbs 5:12
content: 12 Then you will say, “I hated it extremely when people corrected me! Indeed, I scorned people when they rebuked me!

title: Proverbs 5:13
content: 13 I did not obey the people who taught me. Indeed, I did not listen carefully to the people who instructed me.

title: Proverbs 5:14
content: 14 My people are close to considering me as someone who has wasted his life.”

title: Proverbs 5:15
content: 15 {So be like} someone who only drinks water from his own well; have sex with your wife only.

title: Proverbs 5:16
content: 16 {Do not be like} someone who lets his water run out into the streets; never have sex with other women!

title: Proverbs 5:17
content: 17 Only have sex with your own wife! Do not have sex with other women!

title: Proverbs 5:18
content: 18 {As a result,} may Yahweh bless your marriage {with children}; enjoy {sexually} the woman whom you married when you were young!

title: Proverbs 5:19
content: 19 {She is as beautiful as} a loving deer and a graceful mountain goat. Let her breasts satisfy you always. Constantly be exhilarated by how she loves you.

title: Proverbs 5:20
content: 20 My son, you should never be exhilarated by an adulterous woman! You should never passionately caress an immoral woman!

title: Proverbs 5:21
content: 21 {Never do that} because Yahweh fully knows what people do. Indeed, he knows everything that people do.

title: Proverbs 5:22
content: 22 The wicked things that wicked people do are {like} traps that catch them; the sinful things that they do are {like} ropes by which others can grab them.

title: Proverbs 5:23
content: 23 Those wicked people will die because they did not discipline themselves. They will do what kills them because they are extremely foolish.

title: Proverbs 6:1
content: 1 My child, if you guarantee to pay a loan for someone you meet, {that is, if} you agree to pay a loan for someone you do not know,

title: Proverbs 6:2
content: 2 {if in this way} you have said things that you regret {because} it would be very difficult for you {to fulfill} what you promised,

title: Proverbs 6:3
content: 3 then, my child, do this in order to save yourself {from having to pay back this loan}: humbly go to that person and beg him {to cancel what you have promised}, because he now controls you.

title: Proverbs 6:4
content: 4 Do not wait until tomorrow; {go immediately!} do not allow yourself to rest {until you go and talk to him}.

title: Proverbs 6:5
content: 5 Save yourself {immediately}, as if you were a deer fleeing from a hunter or a bird fleeing from a trapper.

title: Proverbs 6:6
content: 6 You lazy person, learn {something} from {watching} ants! Consider what ants do so that you can be wise.

title: Proverbs 6:7
content: 7 Absolutely no one tells ants what to do.

title: Proverbs 6:8
content: 8 {Nevertheless,} they work hard all during the summer, gathering and storing food {to eat during the winter}.

title: Proverbs 6:9
content: 9 {But} you lazy person, stop sleeping! Wake up!

title: Proverbs 6:10
content: 10 {If you say to yourself,} “Let me sleep just a little more! Let me lay my hands {across my chest} in order to rest comfortably for a little while longer!”

title: Proverbs 6:11
content: 11 Then {the result of being so lazy will be that} you will become poor and needy just as surely as if a thief has robbed you.

title: Proverbs 6:12
content: 12 {I will describe for you what} worthless, sinful people {do. They} constantly deceive people by what they say.

title: Proverbs 6:13
content: 13 They make gestures, such as winking their eyes, signaling with their feet, and pointing their fingers {to communicate their evil plans to their friends}.

title: Proverbs 6:14
content: 14 They are always thinking perversely while planning how to do evil things. They cause people to argue {with each other}.

title: Proverbs 6:15
content: 15 Because of this, disastrous things will suddenly happen to those people. Someone will destroy them instantly and they will not be able to recover.

title: Proverbs 6:16
content: 16 Yahweh absolutely hates six, no, seven things:

title: Proverbs 6:17
content: 17 being proud, speaking falsely, someone murdering a person who has not done anything wrong,

title: Proverbs 6:18
content: 18 someone planning ways to act sinfully, someone eagerly looking for ways to act wickedly,

title: Proverbs 6:19
content: 19 someone who naturally lies when testifying, and someone causing members of the same family to argue.

title: Proverbs 6:20
content: 20 My child, be mindful to obey what I, your father, have commanded {you}. Indeed, obey the rules that your mother has commanded.

title: Proverbs 6:21
content: 21 Remember what we have taught you as if it were always a part of you. Indeed, {remember these lessons as if} you wore them like a necklace.

title: Proverbs 6:22
content: 22 The wise things that we have taught you will help you to know what you should do as you go about each day. They will cause you to be safe when you sleep. When you wake up {in the morning}, they will be what will continue to instruct you.

title: Proverbs 6:23
content: 23 {This is so} because what I have commanded {you} is {like} a lamp {that shows you your way}. Indeed, the rules {we taught you} are {like} a light {to guide you}. When we rebuke you while instructing you, {we do that} so that you can do what will give you a good life.

title: Proverbs 6:24
content: 24 {We taught you these lessons} in order to prevent you from {going to} wicked women, {and to prevent you} from {believing} the seductive talk of immoral women.

title: Proverbs 6:25
content: 25 Do not think lustfully about her beautiful body. Do not let her seduce you by the {flirtatious} way she looks at you.

title: Proverbs 6:26
content: 26 {Do not do so} because, although having sex with a prostitute may only cost you a cheap meal, {doing so with} an {adulterous} married woman will cause you to die.

title: Proverbs 6:27
content: 27 A man cannot hold fire against his chest without burning his clothes!

title: Proverbs 6:28
content: 28 No one can walk on burning coals without blistering his feet!

title: Proverbs 6:29
content: 29 It is similar with anyone who has sex with another man’s wife. People will certainly punish anyone who does that.

title: Proverbs 6:30
content: 30 People do not resent someone who steals if he only steals {food} because he is hungry.

title: Proverbs 6:31
content: 31 Nevertheless, if people catch thieves, those thieves must pay back seven times {as much as they stole to those from whom they stole}. They may have to give everything that they own {in order to repay what they stole}.

title: Proverbs 6:32
content: 32 By contrast, a man who acts adulterously with a woman is not thinking. By doing this, he destroys himself!

title: Proverbs 6:33
content: 33 {The woman’s husband} will injure him, people will despise him, and he will always be ashamed.

title: Proverbs 6:34
content: 34 {This is so} because the jealous husband will become furious. He will act mercilessly when he revenges himself {on the man who acted adulterously with his wife}.

title: Proverbs 6:35
content: 35 That jealous husband will not accept any money {to stop being furious}, no matter how much money you offer him.

title: Proverbs 7:1
content: 1 My son, obey what I have told you. Carefully remember the things that I have commanded you.

title: Proverbs 7:2
content: 2 Do what I have commanded {you}, so that you will live {long and well}. Consider the rules I have taught you to be the most precious things that you possess.

title: Proverbs 7:3
content: 3 Constantly remind yourself of the things that I have commanded you. Memorize them!

title: Proverbs 7:4
content: 4 Love what is wise as if it were your sister. Indeed, love what you should understand as if it were a close relative.

title: Proverbs 7:5
content: 5 {Do this} so that you will be able to stay away from adulterous women, and {stay away} from immoral women who speak {to you} seductively.

title: Proverbs 7:6
content: 6 {I was} once {standing} near the window {in my house}, and I looked down {from above the street} through the shutters on the window.

title: Proverbs 7:7
content: 7 Then I observed {someone} among the naive people. I noticed among the youths a young man who does not think wisely.

title: Proverbs 7:8
content: 8 He walked down the street near the corner of {the road where} the adulterous woman {dwells}. Then he walked on the path toward her house.

title: Proverbs 7:9
